Package fr.cytech.safeexit.model.tracking

Class PositionRecord

java.lang.Object
fr.cytech.safeexit.model.tracking.PositionRecord
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class PositionRecord extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable snapshot of an agent position at a given instant.

The AgentTracker stores a chronological list of these records per agent, which lets the views draw a trajectory and build a passage heatmap. An agent is either standing on a Node (edge == null) or travelling on an Edge (node == null).

Version:
1.0
Author:
GROUPE E
